title: ui: delete ui-only quality structs
description: Remove QualityScore and QualityDimension from src/components/discover/quality_score.rs. Replace with domain types.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL render domain quality models directly in the UI.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL use the domain::QualityReport type.

unwanted.condition: IF the UI defines its own quality data structures
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow them to coexist

title: ui: update quality bar to use domain report
description: Refactor QualityScoreBar component to accept domain::QualityReport as a prop. Standardize dimension rendering.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL display quality scores based on the unified math engine.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL update the progress bar color.

unwanted.condition: IF a dimension is missing from the report
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT crash the UI

invariants: Scores in UI match logic scores 1:1

title: ui: update field card to use domain answer
description: Refactor FieldCard component to use the canonical domain::Answer type. Ensure field locking works with unified types.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL use the canonical Answer type for all field cards.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL update the domain::Answer value.

unwanted.condition: IF an answer is partially updated
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow out-of-sync state

invariants: Field IDs must match step IDs in DiscoverySession

title: ui: implement unified quality tooltip
description: Create a shared tooltip component for displaying QualityIssue reports across the UI. Ensures consistent error messaging.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide descriptive feedback for all quality issues.

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a user hovers over a low score
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL show the QualityIssue description and suggestion.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT overlap tooltips

invariants: Tooltip content is derived directly from QualityIssue variants

title: ui: wire lattice engine to server functions
description: Expose the side-effect-free LatticeEngine to the Dioxus frontend via server functions. Allow async analysis triggering.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL perform complex analysis on the server-side.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL trigger an async lattice analysis call.

unwanted.condition: IF the analysis takes too long
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT block the UI thread

postconditions: analyze_session function is available to frontend
invariants: Server functions must return domain types only
